import bisect, itertools

n, m = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
n1 = n // 2

# generate all subset sums modulo m by iterating over combinations of lengths
def all_sums(start, end):
    nums = a[start:end]
    sums = {0}
    for x in nums:
        sums |= {(s + x) % m for s in sums}
    return list(sums)

a1 = sorted(all_sums(0, n1))
a2 = all_sums(n1, n)

ans = 0
for i in a2:
    j = bisect.bisect_left(a1, m - i)
    ans = max(ans, a1[j - 1] + i)
print(ans)
</original_code>
